notes.title: Dros V1.3 patch update
notes.content:
V1.3
-Added Challenge Runs:
After finishing the game, you can access challenge runs of individual levels from the main menu. You can enable individual challenge trackers or counters on the HUD to keep track of various things such as *No Damage*, *Number of Jumps*, *Distance Moved* and more...
You can also run the "Full game" to keep a consistent challenge and time from the very start of the game until the very end.
-Added option to see your % summary directly on the main menu after finishing the game
-Made all dialogue skippable
-Fixed being able to move during some cutscenes
-Minor tweaks to various levels to avoid softlocks
-Tweaks to some checkpoints to make them more useful
-Many minor tweaks to clean up some levels

notes.title: Dros 15% Launch Discount Almost Finished + Game Updates
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

There’s only a few hours left to pick up a copy of Dros with the 15% Launch Discount.  So don’t miss this opportunity!

It’s been 6 days since we launched and the response from our players has been really positive. We were so happy to put out a version of Dros that people love and we are looking forward to making it even better. 

[h1]Post Game - Challenge Runs[/h1]

Next week we’ll be pushing out a post launch update containing additional challenges! We have a had a great response from players finding new ways to explore the levels so we’ll be expanding these features. 

[previewyoutube=IqZRjwBrjSc;full][/previewyoutube]

The update will include many cool new ways to replay your favourite levels including:

[list]
[*] Can you complete checkpoints without using Prima?
[*] Can you complete Oubliette by only jumping 5 times?
[*] Can you complete the entire game in under an hour?
[*] Can you complete the Factory level by only moving Captain 30 metres?
[*] Not for the faint of heart... Can you complete the entire game without taking damage? 
[/list]
We also really appreciate your reviews on Steam. Your reviews help a small studio like us to gain extra exposure and get noticed. So keep them rolling in.

We are really proud of what we have created with Dros and are grateful for all of your feedback. If you want to leave us any the best way is to post on the Steam community forums or by joining our Discord here: discord.gg/KYuKwJzht7


Lastly, thanks for playing Dros. We have a small community at the moment but it’s a passionate one that’s growing everyday. We appreciate you all! 

The Dros Team,
Ben, Tim & Deon ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: Dros launching on Steam July 20
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

We have some exciting news to share with you all. Dros will be launching on Steam and the Steam Deck on Thursday 20th of July!

We have been crafting the world of Dros for over 3 years now, (close to 4 years) pouring our heart and soul into the game. We are looking forward to you meeting all of the different characters, solving puzzles, unlocking world lore and collecting all the cool and strange items.

We’ll be keeping you updated in the lead up to the launch.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=TisJKHSTB10

[h1][b]About the game[/b][/h1]
Discover the world of Dros, a beautifully detailed story-driven adventure about a slimy little creature and her human bounty hunter shell.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1554650/DROS/

[h1][b]Key Features[/b][/h1]

[b]DUAL-CHARACTER PLAY[/b]
Use both characters' abilities to make it through the Tower. Jump, squirm and stealth around as Little Dros and fight off creepy enemies as Captain.

[b]STRANGE CHARACTERS IN A STEAMPUNK WORLD[/b]
As you journey upward through the Tower you'll converse with a range of other strange beings. Each character has their own story to tell...their own struggles. No one is truly good or truly evil.

[b]PUZZLES & ADVENTURE[/b]
Inside the Tower use both brains and brawn to solve puzzles, take on enemies and collect alchemical treasures. Unlock journal entries that expand world lore and flesh out character backstories.

notes.title: March update - DROS store page is up!
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

While the rest of the world is leaving behind the colder days, we are moving into my favourite season: Autumn! What better way to mark the seasonal shift than a brand new Store page!

DROS is a 3rd-person action adventure game being developed by Aussie studio emergeworlds. 
If this is your first peek of our new game-in-production DROS, then welcome! Glad you stopped by :)

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/39986952/f4016b5554aced71b932fad2b3e84e62ac48a0b8.png[/img]

We've been hard at work on a dinky little demo over the past year and are finally starting to spread the word. It's still early days yet but seeds have been planted, soil has been tilled and we're seeing lots of cool little Drossy sprouts pop up everywhere. In other words, things are going great and we're keen to share what we've been creating.

In DROS, we were keen to explore the relationship of two becoming one...a kind of awkward symbiotic character study :) What does it mean to rely on another? To be together and then to be apart?
Far from taking ourselves too seriously though...DROS was a way we could play with this idea and 
have some fun with it. Our two protagonists, the burly Captain and the nimble Little Dros find themselves both out of luck...literally at deaths door. The only way either can survive is with the other.
But don't for a second think it's a match made in heaven...

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/39986952/062e785b9053baccd79aa29495fe3d1f40fbba4d.png[/img]

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/39986952/01b24eb86750aafc2f29a31e26bc658d220b85d6.png[/img]

DROS are slimy alchemical creatures who need to jump into a shell to survive. Little DROS is our plucky little symbiote and Captain is her disgruntled host. To solve puzzles and defeat enemies players will be able to attach and detach Little DROS from her host. For combat and anything requiring a [i]'direct'[/i] approach players will need to use the Captain. For nimble platforming, travelling down pipes and squirming into small spaces they can detach and use Little Dros.

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/39986952/4c4882233df6bfe4efcd4246d26528dc7ed54c66.png[/img]

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/39986952/c2c811e75d4619e714118f53167fc292e959d8ca.png[/img]

With a bunch of playable demo stages under our belt we're moving now into full production. It's time to put into practice the lessons we've learned and the systems we've setup. Our initial vertical slice goal was to demonstrate not only the mechanics of the game but the atmosphere of the world and the stories of the characters within. I'm happy to report that we've achieved just that! We're lucky to have a group  of very talented devs crafting this world and designing it's gameplay and it's exciting to see the game take shape as weeks go by. I look forward to our next update when we'll share new milestone features and more news! 

In the meantime, enjoy some screenshots from our vertical slice demo and some recent concept art and 3D modelling from our artists. And if you like what you see don't forget to wishlist DROS and pay us a visit on the DROS official Discord.
Now for a coffee!
-Ben
